parsed_output.overall_summary: This video is a cooking tutorial for Chicken Arayes, a Middle Eastern dish featuring pita bread stuffed with a flavorful meat mixture. The creator, Ruhama, demonstrates how to prepare the filling using ground chicken, fresh herbs, onions, and a variety of spices including sumac, cumin, and harissa. The stuffed pitas are first pan-seared to achieve a crispy exterior and then finished in the oven to ensure the chicken is fully cooked. The final dish is presented with traditional toppings like tahini, red onions, and amba sauce.

takeaways.statement: Chicken Arayes are a juicy and flavorful Middle Eastern stuffed pita dish.
Searing the pita face-down before baking ensures a crispy texture and locks in the meat's juices.
Using harissa and preserved lemon adds a specific depth of flavor to the chicken filling.

items.name: Chicken Filling
items.details: Ground chicken, chopped herbs (parsley/cilantro), red onion, jalapeño, salt, sumac, cumin, New York Shuk Harissa with Preserved Lemon, olive oil, and one egg.

items.name: Cooking Method
items.details: Pan-fry face down for 5 minutes until golden, then finish in the oven.

items.name: Toppings
items.details: Tahini sauce, sliced red onions, fresh parsley, and amba (mango sauce).

parsed_output.embedding_text: In this TikTok video, creator Ruhama (@ruhamasfood) shares a recipe for juicy Chicken Arayes, a Middle Eastern stuffed pita dish. The tutorial begins with a close-up of the golden-brown pitas frying in a pan. Ruhama demonstrates mixing ground chicken with herbs, onion, jalapeño, salt, sumac, cumin, and New York Shuk Harissa with preserved lemon, along with olive oil and an egg.
